baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cutting verb directly governs the named watin in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A concrete severing action targets the inner vessel whose integrity sustains life, so the threatened intervention is exact and immediately fatal rather than generically violent.

activation_trace.role: Physical severing supplies the concrete action and makes the intervention irreversible.
The life-vein supplies the precise internal target and the lethal consequence of its loss.

changed_reading.before: The ayah threatens an unspecified bodily punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah threatens a controlled fatal cut at the body's indispensable life-line.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a cutting root that can mark cessation with a watin root that can mark persistence and adherence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots form a polarity: what remains fixed and continuously attached is made to reach its endpoint. The anatomical act therefore also reads as termination of the subject's continuing hold on life.

activation_trace.role: Cessation and endpoint turn the cut into the ending of an ongoing condition.
Persistence and adherence make the target the subject's continuing attachment to life.

changed_reading.before: Cutting is only a momentary physical action.
changed_reading.after: Cutting is the imposed endpoint of the continuity by which the subject remains alive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines severance of connection with the watin's image of extreme nearness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The threat reaches past external defenses to rupture the attachment nearest to the person. Intimacy and dependence are not shelters here; they identify the most decisive point of access.

activation_trace.role: Severance of connection makes the cut a rupture of attachment as well as tissue.
Extreme nearness locates the threatened rupture at what is most intimately joined to the subject.

changed_reading.before: The threat approaches the subject from outside.
changed_reading.after: The threat acts through the subject's nearest and most dependent attachment, making inward proximity the point of rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's fixed truth survives while bodies and peoples lose every remainder. The focus distinguishes the severable continuity of a bearer from the non-severable stability of what is true and certain.

activation_trace.role: Cessation marks the bearer as capable of being brought to an endpoint.
Persistence supplies the mortal continuity that can be interrupted.
Reality fixed against falsehood establishes an invariant at the surah's opening.
The remnant image, under negation in the ayah, shows created continuity reduced to nothing.
Fixed correspondence with reality returns after the threat and remains untouched by the bearer's vulnerability.
Stable knowledge without doubt reinforces the message-side continuity of the contrast.

structural_cues: The fixed-truth root frames the surah at 69:1-3 and returns immediately after the threat at 69:51.
The focus lies between the conditional fabrication scene and the renewed assertion of truth and certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed truth, erased remnants, stable certainty, and a cut persistent life-line; I infer a contrast between durable message and interruptible bearer. A live alternative is that these are separate assertions with no bearer-message asymmetry.

changed_reading.before: The focus only ends the life of a false speaker.
changed_reading.after: The focus demonstrates that the bearer is expendable while the truth he bears remains fixed and does not depend on his survival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obligation, an adjudicating record, oath, and the oath-capable right hand surround a focus cutting branch that can settle a right. The bodily penalty can therefore coexist with a juridical reading as the sanction attached to a truth claim.

activation_trace.role: Deciding a matter or right lets the physical cut also function as final adjudication.
The life-vein supplies the concrete penalty securing the adjudication.
Binding obligation establishes a legal rather than merely descriptive register for truth.
A written record that imposes judgment supplies the adjudicative instrument.
The oath image frames the authenticity claim as formally staked speech.
The oath branch keeps a covenantal activation alive alongside hand and force readings of the same word.

structural_cues: An oath introduces the authenticity section, and the conditional protasis in 69:44 is followed by a specified sanction in 69:45-46.
The same yamin form can remain bodily, powerful, and oath-related without being disambiguated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, judicial writing, oath, yamin, and decisive settlement; I infer a covenant-like sanction whose penalty is embodied in the focus. A live alternative is that yamin means only hand or force and the legal pattern is rhetorical rather than contractual.

changed_reading.before: The cut is an arbitrary threat attached to a hypothetical offense.
changed_reading.after: The cut is the bodily sanction that closes an oath-framed adjudication of claimed revelation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier excess crosses a limit and is answered by an uprooting, decisive cutoff; even water becomes destructive when it overflows. Fabricated attribution is the speech-level boundary crossing, and cutting the watin is its individualized cutoff.

activation_trace.role: Cessation gives the recurring excess-response pattern its terminal action.
Persistent life is the particular continuity ended when verbal excess reaches the bearer.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the abstract shape of the offense.
Uprooting termination supplies the large-scale consequence of unchecked excess.
Overflow makes limit-crossing material and shows a sustaining flow becoming destructive through excess.
Attributing speech that never was identifies the hypothetical verbal form of overreach.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly places a transgressive act before a terminating consequence.
The conditional fabrication in 69:44 immediately initiates the same offense-to-consequence order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing, overflow, uprooting termination, false attribution, and the focus cutoff; I infer one causal law moving from collective and fluid excess to verbal excess. A live alternative is that the earlier destructions are precedent only, without this mechanism-level correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The cut is a unique penalty for one hypothetical lie.
changed_reading.after: The cut is the personal-scale instance of the surah's repeated law that overreach is answered by ending the offender's continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus completes a repeated judicial sequence: culpable subjects are taken, restrained, subjected to a further consequence, and denied escape or interposition. The watin cut is a controlled execution inside custody, not an uncontrolled blow.

activation_trace.role: Concrete severing supplies the terminal operation after capture.
The life-vein makes the operation exact, embodied, and fatal.
Seizure for wrongdoing supplies an earlier culpability-to-custody precedent.
Increase and height intensify the earlier seizure and establish escalation.
Capture and arrest begin a second explicit punishment sequence.
Restraint around a limb shows custody becoming bodily immobilization.
Capture immediately before the focus supplies the first stage of the hypothetical execution.
Power and right make the seizure both effective and jurisdictional.
A separating barrier, explicitly unavailable in the ayah, closes every route of intervention.

structural_cues: The أخذ root recurs at 69:10, 69:30, and 69:45, each time initiating or naming punitive custody.
The ثم sequence in 69:31-32 is echoed by ثم at the start of the focus after the seizure in 69:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three seizures, bodily restraint, force, sequential consequences, and failed interposition; I infer a recurrent custody protocol culminating in the focus. A live alternative is that the repetitions intensify tone without defining a shared procedure.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts a sudden isolated wound.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the exact terminal stage of a repeated seizure-restraint-execution protocol from which no barrier can extract the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah assembles carriers at several scales: a vessel bears people through flow, an ear receives and a heart contains reminder, a messenger bears utterance, and descent delivers it. The watin is the body's corresponding carrier of life; severing it makes carrier integrity the enforcement point for message integrity.

activation_trace.role: Severing supplies the failure mode of a carrier whose continuity is withdrawn.
The life-feeding vessel anchors the conduit analogy inside the focus body.
Visible carrying supplies the first preservation-bearing function.
Flow gives the carrier a medium through which continuity must be maintained.
The reminder supplies the content that must survive transmission and reception.
Containing meaning in the heart supplies an inward receiving vessel.
Attentive acceptance supplies the aperture through which the reminder enters.
Spoken output supplies the message in transmissible form.
Messenger and message supply the human carrier relation under scrutiny.
Delivery from a source supplies the upstream direction of the transmission chain.

structural_cues: Carrying, reception, utterance, messengerhood, and delivery recur in that order across the surah.
The conditional offense is insertion into transmitted speech, while the consequence attacks the bearer's own internal carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical carriage, flowing medium, receptive containment, spoken message, messenger, descent, and a life-vessel; I infer a cross-scale carrier analogy in which source control guarantees integrity. A live alternative is that the watin is only a lethal target and the carrier sequence is thematic rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: The bearer is punished after corrupting a message.
changed_reading.after: The bearer's life-conduit is the embodied integrity seal on a larger delivery chain: corrupting the carried speech causes the source to terminate the carrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth and mountains are pulverized, the sky splits, and its structure becomes weak; the focus compresses that dismantling into one body. Cutting the watin is a personal-scale collapse of the subject's innermost structural support.

activation_trace.role: Physical severance supplies the bodily-scale counterpart of cosmic opening and demolition.
The central life-vessel localizes structural collapse inside one person.
Pulverizing demolition supplies the macro-scale removal of solid support.
Splitting open supplies the closest cosmic analogue to the focus incision.
Structural slackness and weakness supply the state produced when integrity fails.

structural_cues: The cosmic sequence moves from lifting to crushing to splitting and weakness.
Both the cosmic scene and the focus use one decisive structural breach to make a whole system fail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demolition, splitting, weakness, and a fatal inner severance; I infer a scale analogy from cosmos to body. A live alternative is that the two destruction scales only intensify one another without sharing a structural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an anatomical punishment detached from the judgment imagery.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a personal apocalypse: one inner split collapses the bearer as the earlier splits collapse the ordered world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Public display, the removal of hiding, the visible/unseen pair, divine knowing, and a cover/uncover reversal make the internal watin an evidentiary site. A hidden act of false attribution would be answered where ordinary observers cannot see, turning concealed authorship into undeniable embodied disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The incision supplies an act that opens an otherwise concealed interior.
The hidden life-vessel anchors disclosure at a normally unseen bodily depth.
Presentation for inspection supplies the public side of the disclosure mechanism.
Removal of concealment supplies the reversal from hidden act to manifest evidence.
Eyesight marks the domain available to ordinary witnesses.
The same eyesight image under negation marks the inaccessible domain in which the inner target lies.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access that does not depend on human sight.
Stripping a cover supplies the downstream unveiling action.
Covering supplies the opposed concealment that the sequence reverses.

structural_cues: The surah moves from nothing hidden at presentation to an oath over what is seen and unseen, then to known deniers and an uncovering/covering pair.
The alleged fabrication is private, but its threatened proof is lodged in an interior no human witness controls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies display, concealment removed, visible and invisible domains, knowing, cover, uncovering, and an inner life-vessel; I infer an evidentiary exposure mechanism. A live alternative is that the cut only punishes, while the visibility language addresses judgment independently.

changed_reading.before: The cut privately kills a hypothetical fabricator.
changed_reading.after: The cut makes control of the unseen interior the proof that concealed fabrication cannot evade the source's knowledge or exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The right hand first receives and displays a vindicating record, while the left receives the condemning one; the right hand then returns as the force that seizes a hypothetical falsifier. The focus enforces the integrity of what can be handed over and read.

activation_trace.role: Decisive settlement makes the cut the final judgment attached to handed records.
The life-vein turns the judgment motif into an embodied sanction.
The right hand first marks favorable receipt and public possession.
A record imposing judgment supplies the object whose integrity is publicly readable.
The left-hand direction establishes the opposed outcome in the handed-account system.
Right as power and entitlement reverses reception into authorized capture.

structural_cues: The sequence presents right-hand record, left-hand record, and then right-hand seizure before the focus.
Both record scenes contain speech about a book, while the threat concerns unauthorized speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed handed records, imposed judgment, unauthorized speech, and seizure by yamin; I infer a reversal from receiving authenticated text to enforcing its authenticity. A live alternative is that the two yamin occurrences share no function beyond the ordinary hand image.

changed_reading.before: The right-hand seizure is only a detail of how the body is held.
changed_reading.after: The seizure reverses the earlier right-hand reception scene: the hand associated with an authenticated record becomes the power that enforces the record's untampered source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pleasant eating is granted in one outcome, while failure to urge feeding produces deprivation in the other. Because the watin branch explicitly carries life-supply to an inner organ, its cutting becomes withdrawal of the most basic nourishment from a bearer who would corrupt guidance.

activation_trace.role: Cessation turns vascular cutting into termination of supply.
The vessel that feeds an inner organ anchors the nourishment mechanism directly in the focus.
An edible share or sustenance supplies the positive outcome of maintained provision.
Urging action supplies the omitted social mechanism that should move nourishment toward another.
Feeding another supplies the outward life-support relation whose refusal is condemned.
Sustenance and livelihood, negated except for the adverse food in the ayah, supply the deprivation outcome.

structural_cues: The two account outcomes are partly organized by abundant intake versus refusal to support another's intake and consequent deprivation.
The focus names a vessel whose packet description includes feeding the liver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted sustenance, refused feeding, deprivation, and a life-feeding vein; I infer a supply-withdrawal correspondence. A live alternative is that the food scenes concern social duty while the watin is selected only for immediate lethality.

changed_reading.before: The watin is chosen only because cutting it kills quickly.
changed_reading.after: The watin is also the body's provision-line, so its severance enacts the surah's reversal from sustaining life to withholding sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material sufficiency, authority, intimate kin, any individual helper, clan barrier, and protective action all fail in sequence. The focus then reaches the attachment nearer than every external ally, stripping protection from the social perimeter to the inner life-line.

activation_trace.role: Severance of connection lets the anatomical cut also terminate protective relations.
Extreme nearness places the final vulnerable attachment inside every social perimeter.
Sufficiency, explicitly denied in the ayah, removes material self-protection.
Authority and power, said to be gone, remove institutional protection.
Near kinship, absent in the ayah, removes intimate social protection.
Exhaustive negation removes every possible individual intervener.
Interposition by a separator supplies the physical or procedural barrier that is unavailable.
Origin and clan supply the social shield that likewise cannot intervene.
Protective prevention supplies the contrasting posture that avoids rather than blocks the consequence.

structural_cues: The failed supports move from property and authority to intimate relation, any person, and finally any barrier.
The pronoun sequence in 69:45-47 keeps the same exposed subject in view while possible protectors are excluded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, vanished authority, absent intimacy, exhaustive negation, clan and barrier, protection, and the nearest inner attachment; I infer an inward stripping of a protection stack. A live alternative is that these failures apply to different judged figures and should not be serialized around the focus subject.

changed_reading.before: The cut defeats only the body's physical integrity.
changed_reading.after: The cut is the innermost endpoint of total exposure after wealth, office, kin, individuals, and barriers have all failed as protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Legitimate sending can arrive in successive pieces, but the hypothetical offense inserts a fabricated portion among sayings. The focus answers unauthorized textual segmentation with bodily segmentation, excising the life-bearing part from the would-be splicer.

activation_trace.role: Division and apportionment make the bodily action formally answer a segmented textual offense.
A separated portion supplies the excised bodily counterpart to an inserted verbal portion.
The life-bearing part raises the answer from proportional wordplay to total mortal consequence.
Succession in pieces preserves a legitimate mode of serial transmission.
Attribution of speech that never existed marks the inserted segment as counterfeit.
A part or segment identifies the offense as splicing even a portion rather than replacing the whole discourse.

structural_cues: The offense is quantified as only part of the sayings, but the consequence targets the bearer at a single indispensable part.
The sequence distinguishes received seriality from unauthorized insertion rather than treating all partition as corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate successive pieces, a fabricated attributed portion, focus division, and an excisable life-part; I infer a talionic splice-to-excision symmetry. A live alternative is that 'some sayings' only minimizes the threshold of guilt and does not shape the penalty's imagery.

changed_reading.before: Any amount of fabrication simply triggers a lethal penalty.
changed_reading.after: The penalty mirrors the offense: an unauthorized verbal piece spliced into transmission is answered by excising the bearer's indispensable bodily piece.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's segmented-verse branch inside a literal anatomical threat. It remains anchored in the focus cutting verb and in the nearby poet/fabricated-speech frame. Downstream prose should present it as a metapoetic echo, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus cutting root includes a branch for cut-off speech and metrical segmentation, while the named watin keeps the lethal bodily reading active.

activation_trace.role: Segmented verse and truncated speech let the threatened cut reverberate inside the discourse being authenticated.
The life-vein contains the wordplay within a literal fatal target.
Poetry supplies the explicitly rejected discourse class in which metrical cutting would normally operate.
Invented attribution supplies the speech that would be cut off along with its bearer.

changed_reading.before: Only the fabricator's body is cut.
changed_reading.after: The threat also imagistically cuts off and segments the fabricated discourse at the point where it would emerge from its bearer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus names a vascular target while the activated branches evoke breath-cutting and a grip at the feeding passage. It remains valid as a cross-anatomical mechanism anchored in the focus cutting root and nearby food/throat imagery. Downstream prose should call it a suffocation echo, not replace the watin with the throat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus cutting root itself contains a breath-cutting branch, while the watin keeps the consequence tied to loss of life.

activation_trace.role: Breath cut by strangling supplies an alternate physiological route to the focus's fatal cessation.
The lethal inner vessel prevents the suffocation echo from floating free of the named anatomy.
Mouth and throat passages establish the bodily corridor used for intake.
A grip at the feeding-place during choking supplies the local constriction that activates breath-cutting.

changed_reading.before: The threat works only by bleeding from a severed vessel.
changed_reading.after: A secondary bodily echo makes the cut a shutting of intake and breath as well as loss of vascular life-flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant qawl-to-qill split mapping rather than the ordinary speech root. It remains anchored through the focus branch for incapacity and silencing and the exact fabricated-sayings occurrence. Downstream prose should label it split-map wordplay, not claim that qawl lexically means instability or independent rising here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus cutting root includes incapacity and loss of answer, allowing the bearer of counterfeit speech to be read as made unable to stand or respond.

activation_trace.role: Incapacity and being cut off from answer turn the lethal act into collapse of agency and voice.
Persistence supplies the continuation that failed speech and its bearer cannot maintain.
Independent bearing and rising activate the counterfeit utterance's attempted self-standing authority.
Oscillation and movement make that attempted independence unstable rather than settled.

changed_reading.before: Fabricated speech is refuted as a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: Fabricated speech tries to stand under its own authority, but the cut makes both utterance and bearer unable to stand, continue, or answer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links messenger and denial through two milk-flow branch images rather than their ordinary senses. It remains anchored in the focus polarity of persistent life-flow and cessation. Downstream prose should render it as a material analogy about continuity, not as a translation of messenger or denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a persistent life-vessel to a cutting branch of cessation, providing a clear flow-versus-failure axis.

activation_trace.role: Depletion and endpoint supply the stopping of a previously recurrent flow.
Persistence and adherence supply the continuity expected of a sustaining channel.
Recurring milk-flow supplies a material image for sustained transmission through the messenger relation.
Milk that disappears and does not last supplies the failed-flow image for denial and counterfeit continuity.

changed_reading.before: The cut merely stops blood and kills the bearer.
changed_reading.after: The cut participates in a material contrast between sustained transmission and a false flow that dries up, ending the bearer's claimed continuity at its source.

strongest_changes: The cut became the individualized endpoint of a surah-wide excess, seizure, restraint, and no-interposition pattern.
The watin became a carrier and supply line linking rescue through flow, receptive containment, messenger transmission, descent, and nourishment.
Right-hand and record imagery recast the cut as an authentication judgment, while fixed truth remained stable beyond a severable bearer.
A fabricated portion of sayings activated a splice-to-excision symmetry between textual tampering and bodily division.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported simultaneous anatomical, temporal, juridical, transmission, nourishment, social, cosmic, and metapoetic mechanisms. The most diagnostic surprises came from preserving polysemy in yamin, treating the watin as both life-vessel and continuity, and carrying branch-distant split-map and material-flow readings without promoting them to lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet leaves the watin's exact anatomy distributed among heart, inner body, cardiac attachment, and liver-feeding vessel descriptions.
Hand, force, right, and oath activations of yamin remain live together; the trace does not disambiguate them.
The cosmic-body, nourishment, and carrier correspondences depend on reader-supplied cross-scale arrows rather than explicit causal syntax.
The metrical, throat-grip, failed-milk, and non-dominant split-map readings should remain qualified exploratory echoes.
